name: Kale

companions.note: Repels cabbage worms and aphids, attracts pollinators
Deters aphids and other soft-bodied pests

antagonists.note: Both are heavy feeders; compete for nutrients and may inhibit each other's growth

pnw_notes: One of the best year-round crops for zone 8b. Flavor improves significantly after frost — sweeter and more complex. Can overwinter in the ground with no protection. Cut outer leaves for continuous production rather than harvesting the whole plant.

planting_windows.notes: Start 6-8 weeks before last frost for spring transplants
Spring crop; sow when soil can be worked
Sow for fall and winter harvest; most rewarding planting window in PNW
Harvest outer leaves continuously; plant persists through Portland winters
